summary: Resource-striping misalignment causes hot-shard overload and elevated 5xx baseline in us-east during tenant burst
description:
Issue summary:
Customer BrightCart reported sustained elevated 5xx error-rate (502/503) and high p50/p95 latency for API requests during a sustained tenant ramp. Symptoms correlate with a tenant burst between 2026-03-13T13:40Z and 2026-03-13T14:10Z.

Impact:
- Multiple production requests returned 502/503 to BrightCart (affects checkout and search flows).
- Error rate increased from baseline ~0.2% to ~6% for the tenant's traffic slice in us-east.
- Customer reports increased tail latency and occasional streaming disconnects.

Environment:
- prod-us-east (us-east-1)
- Dedicated pool: dp-us-east-42 (tenant pinned)
- Model in use: redwood/gpt-3-small-v1 (pinned)

Steps to reproduce (observed):
1) BrightCart runs parallel bulk-embedding upload followed by high-concurrency prompt traffic (spike to 700 RPS).
2) Autoscaler warms new runners but routing layer assigns a disproportionate fraction of sessions to a small subset of runtimes (hot striping).
3) Affected runtimes experience KV-cache churn, prefetch thrash and then OOM-like GPU evictions leading to upstream 5xxs.

Logs / Evidence (snips):
- apigw-prod us-east accept-queue: "WARN accept_queue.go:214 hot-shard detected: tenant=brightcart sessions=312 target_pool=dp-us-east-42"
- runtime dp-us-east-42 node-13: "ERROR runtime/serve.go:487 kvcache eviction spike -> prefetch_failure: retry_count=6"
- runtime node-13 nvml: "WARN nvml: gpu_mem_fragmentation high, device-reset initiated"
- apigw 502 sample: "502 upstream reset: upstream=runtime-node-13 conn_status=closed reason=eviction"
comments: 2026-03-13 14:05 - Support (Maya): Opened ticket after receiving BrightCart alert and logs. Notified SRE channel #sre-prod-us-east.

2026-03-13 14:12 - SRE (Omar): Observed uneven session distribution across dp-us-east-42; one host (node-13) serving ~40% of sessions. Added temporary routing weight adjustment to reduce load on node-13.
2026-03-13 14:25 - Support (Maya): Customer confirms slight reduction in 5xx but still elevated errors. Providing workaround: retry with exponential backoff and 10s jitter.

2026-03-13 15:00 - Infra (Priya): Autoscaler logs show scale-up completed but new instances joined in the same AZ and were immediately assigned to the same shard due to stale striping table. Investigating striping sync path.

2026-03-14 09:30 - Eng (Lena): Identified race in striping controller where newly provisioned nodes received default shard assignment before striping rebalance. Drafting patch to delay join until shard rebalance event completes (PR linked).
investigation_notes:
Preliminary hypothesis: 'resource-striping misalignment' — routing/striping controller assigned new capacity without triggering a global rebalance, creating a hot shard. Hot shard caused sustained KV-cache thrash on node-13 -> prefetch failures -> GPU memory fragmentation -> runtime evictions and upstream 5xxs. We observed: 1) accept queue skew metrics, 2) high kvcache eviction rates on node-13, 3) nvml warnings and soft-resets.

Data points collected:
- routing metrics: shard_load_percentile: node-13=0.42 vs median=0.07 during spike
- kvcache eviction rate: node-13=172 ev/s (baseline 12 ev/s)
- runtime restart count: node-13=3 restarts in 30m
- apigw 502 rate for tenant slice: peak 6%

Actions taken so far:
- Manual routing weight adjustment to rebalance sessions away from node-13 (mitigated immediate saturation).
- Temporarily increased autoscaler target to add capacity in another pool and started failover routing to dp-us-east-43 (cold).
- Collected heap/proc maps and nvml logs for node-13 and pushed to /var/archives/sre/314271/ for post-mortem.

Open investigation items:
- Confirm root cause of striping controller race and fix window where new nodes are given default shard assignments.
- Validate kvcache eviction thresholds and whether prefetch cancellation logic amplified thrash.
- Determine if tenant-level routing affinity should be relaxed during large bursts to avoid hot-sharding.
resolution:
Status: Partial mitigation applied (2026-03-13). Manual routing rebalance and cross-pool failover reduced tenant 5xxs to ~0.6% by 2026-03-13T16:00Z.

Workaround provided to BrightCart: temporary routing to dp-us-east-43 and recommend client-side retry/backoff for affected endpoints.

Planned permanent fix (next steps):
- Engineering to land striping controller patch to ensure global rebalance occurs before new nodes accept tenant sessions (PR #4821). Target rollout: canary 2026-03-16, full rollout 2026-03-18.
- Add guardrails in routing to detect shard-load imbalance and trigger automated reweighting earlier.
- Tune kvcache eviction thresholds and add early-shed policy to avoid OOM-triggered evictions.

Follow-up: Postmortem and runbook update scheduled (owner: Omar Singh). Customer follow-up scheduled for 2026-03-15 to confirm stability and share mitigation plan.
